title: Does Your Homeowner's Insurance Cover Silver? What the Policy Fine Print Actually Says
description: Your HO-3 caps precious metals theft coverage at $1,500. Here's what's covered, what's not, and how a floater closes the gap for $1 to $2 per $100 per year.
alt: Silver insurance coverage guide showing $1,500 standard HO-3 theft sublimit and how a scheduled floater provides full replacement value
